resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Idaho Lookouts list (the brief's source) says Shoshone; the Forest Lookouts index files BM Hill under Clearwater County. The story names no county and the record keeps the list value; an editor should check a county map.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts (list compiled June 2016)

notes_for_editor: Built 1932 and destroyed 1973 agree across the four history sources, but two of them (FFLA and the FS list) draw on the same older records, so the agreement is less independent than it looks. County conflict unresolved: Shoshone (FFLA list, brief) vs Clearwater (Forest Lookouts index); the story names no county. Distance of nine miles comes from the FS list row, where the number sits on a wrapped line ('R11E 9 / miles N of / Powell RS'). The 40 ft figure is treated as the pole height and converted to 12.2 m. Access level 'restricted' is inferred from the gate; no source states the land's rules. Staffing: the Idaho page says no documented staffing history, so no staffing facts are recorded. Fire cause: no source gives one; the melted-glass remark is a 2025 visitor's inference and is cited as such. Today: only the July 2025 Idaho Fire Lookouts post describes the site. Brief record: no field errors found beyond the county question.
